```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## Purpose

This collects the fitted coefficients of the four GTEx tissue clocks into a
single supplementary table. Each clock was fit and saved by the clock-training
step (`clock_and_RAA_objects-<feature_set>.rds`), so nothing is refit or
recomputed here. The script only reads the stored clocks and lays them out.

The clocks are stored in the standardized form used in the Methods,

`predicted age = b0 + sum_k b_k * (x_k - mu_k) / sigma_k`,

where `mu_k` and `sigma_k` are the GTEx training mean and standard deviation of
pathway `k`. The table reports `b_k`, `mu_k`, and `sigma_k` for every pathway,
plus the per-pathway weight `w_k = b_k / sigma_k` that ClockSHAP uses, and the
intercept `b0` of each clock. A pathway is "retained" when its coefficient is
non-zero.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(here)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(knitr)
  library(reactable)
})

msg <- function(...) if (isTRUE(params$verbose)) message(...)
```

## Clocks

One clock per GTEx tissue. Each is read from the analysis directory of one
TCGA cancer paired with that tissue. Lung and brain are each paired with two
cancers; the second directory of each is compared against the first further
down.

```{r}
clock_map <- list(
  BREAST = "BRCA__BREAST",
  LUNG   = "LUAD__LUNG",
  BRAIN  = "LGG__BRAIN",
  COLON  = "COAD__COLON"
)
```

## Load saved clocks

```{r}
suffix       <- paste0("-", params$feature_set)
out_root_abs <- here::here(params$out_root)

coef_list <- list()

for (tissue in names(clock_map)) {
  clock_path <- file.path(out_root_abs, clock_map[[tissue]],
                          paste0("clock_and_RAA_objects", suffix, ".rds"))
  clock <- readRDS(clock_path)

  feat  <- clock$feature_names
  cs    <- clock$clock_cs
  beta  <- cs$beta;  if (is.null(names(beta)))  names(beta)  <- feat
  mu    <- cs$mu;    if (is.null(names(mu)))    names(mu)    <- feat
  sigma <- cs$sigma; if (is.null(names(sigma))) names(sigma) <- feat

  beta  <- as.numeric(beta[feat])
  mu    <- as.numeric(mu[feat])
  sigma <- as.numeric(sigma[feat])

  # intercept row first, then one row per pathway in the clock's stored order
  coef_list[[tissue]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    tibble(
      Tissue             = tissue,
      Pathway            = "(Intercept)",
      Coefficient_per_SD = as.numeric(cs$alpha),
      GTEx_mean          = NA_real_,
      GTEx_SD            = NA_real_,
      Weight             = NA_real_,
      Retained           = NA
    ),
    tibble(
      Tissue             = tissue,
      Pathway            = feat,
      Coefficient_per_SD = beta,
      GTEx_mean          = mu,
      GTEx_SD            = sigma,
      Weight             = beta / sigma,
      Retained           = is.finite(beta) & beta != 0
    )
  )
}

coef_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(coef_list) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Tissue = factor(Tissue, levels = names(clock_map)))

msg("Loaded ", length(coef_list), " clocks, ", nrow(coef_tbl), " rows.")
```

## Pathways retained per clock

Number of input pathways and of pathways with a non-zero coefficient in each
clock.

```{r}
retained_tbl <- coef_tbl %>%
  dplyr::filter(Pathway != "(Intercept)") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Tissue) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Input_pathways    = dplyr::n(),
    Retained_pathways = sum(Retained),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(
  retained_tbl,
  caption = "Input and retained (non-zero coefficient) pathways per clock."
)
```

## Coefficients by pathway and tissue

Coefficient per GTEx standard deviation of each pathway score (`b_k`, in
years), one column per clock, with the intercept in the first row. A zero means
the clock did not retain that pathway. This is a view of the full table saved
below, shown here rounded to four significant figures.

```{r}
coef_wide <- coef_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(Pathway, Tissue, Coefficient_per_SD) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Tissue, values_from = Coefficient_per_SD)

coef_wide_print <- coef_wide %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 4)))

reactable::reactable(
  coef_wide_print,
  searchable = TRUE, resizable = TRUE, striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 51
)

knitr::kable(
  coef_wide_print,
  caption = "Clock coefficients per GTEx standard deviation of each pathway score (years), by tissue."
)
```

## Full table

One row per tissue and pathway, as saved.

```{r}
reactable::reactable(
  coef_tbl %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 4))),
  searchable = TRUE, resizable = TRUE, striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 51
)
```

## Lung and brain: second analysis directory

The lung clock is fit once in `LUAD__LUNG` and once in `LUSC__LUNG`, and the
brain clock once in `LGG__BRAIN` and once in `GBM__BRAIN`. The table above uses
the first of each pair. This compares the clock stored in the second directory
against it. Differences of zero mean the two directories hold the same clock.

```{r}
shared_map <- list(
  LUNG  = "LUSC__LUNG",
  BRAIN = "GBM__BRAIN"
)

shared_list <- list()

for (tissue in names(shared_map)) {
  clock_a <- readRDS(file.path(out_root_abs, clock_map[[tissue]],
                               paste0("clock_and_RAA_objects", suffix, ".rds")))
  clock_b <- readRDS(file.path(out_root_abs, shared_map[[tissue]],
                               paste0("clock_and_RAA_objects", suffix, ".rds")))

  feat_a <- clock_a$feature_names
  feat_b <- clock_b$feature_names

  beta_a <- clock_a$clock_cs$beta; if (is.null(names(beta_a))) names(beta_a) <- feat_a
  beta_b <- clock_b$clock_cs$beta; if (is.null(names(beta_b))) names(beta_b) <- feat_b

  shared_list[[tissue]] <- tibble(
    Tissue                = tissue,
    Table_clock           = clock_map[[tissue]],
    Second_clock          = shared_map[[tissue]],
    Same_pathways         = setequal(feat_a, feat_b),
    Max_abs_coef_diff     = max(abs(as.numeric(beta_a[feat_a]) - as.numeric(beta_b[feat_a]))),
    Abs_intercept_diff    = abs(as.numeric(clock_a$clock_cs$alpha) - as.numeric(clock_b$clock_cs$alpha))
  )
}

shared_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(shared_list)

knitr::kable(
  shared_tbl,
  caption = "Clock stored in the second analysis directory of each shared tissue, compared against the one used in the table."
)
```

## Save table

```{r}
tables_root_abs <- here::here(params$tables_root)
dir.create(tables_root_abs, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

out_file <- file.path(tables_root_abs, "Supplement_GTEx_clock_coefficients.csv")

utils::write.csv(coef_tbl, file = out_file, row.names = FALSE)

msg("Saved: ", out_file)
```
